note: Dates anchor to a 2026-08-20 start. If the start moves, shift every due date by the same offset.

owners.knomes: Human. Her face, her accounts, her credentials, her judgment.
owners.claude: Copy, code, research, analysis, dashboard upkeep.
owners.openclaw: ASSUMED LANE, not confirmed. Scheduled, credentialed, repetitive work that runs unattended. If it cannot drive a logged-in browser, reassign to knomes.
owners.ember: Candidate owner for anything marked openclaw, if Ember is the right runner instead.

mirror.policy: Mission Control is source of truth. Notion holds a mirror. Reconcile on phase close.

phases.title: Week zero
phases.goal: Nothing gets posted. Accounts warmed, /start shipped, first ten filmed.

phases.title: Amazon track
phases.goal: Once, then it compounds. The half the source method skips.

phases.title: Days 1-30
phases.goal: Not sales. Find which three hooks and which pillar the algorithm rewards.

phases.title: Days 31-60
phases.goal: Kill the losers, re-shoot the winners, concentrate a month of demand into five days.

phases.title: Days 61-90
phases.goal: Turn one book into three. Read-through is where the money is.

tasks.task: Decide the link policy (site by default, Amazon during rank pushes)
tasks.notes: Five minutes. Everything downstream hangs off it.

tasks.task: Create or clean up the 4 platform accounts
tasks.notes: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook. One line of bio, one link.

tasks.task: Supply the keyword list for feed priming and Amazon backend
tasks.notes: 18 phrases. See campaign-90-day.md.

tasks.task: Warm all 4 accounts, 15 to 20 min a day for 3 days
tasks.notes: Human on a phone, no VPN. Cannot be delegated to any agent.

tasks.task: Prime the feeds and save 5 viral videos per platform
tasks.notes: Doubles as the warming activity. Over 100k views, ideally over 1M.

tasks.task: Build the hook harvest sheet
tasks.notes: Platform, views, hook verbatim, its structure, the Momentum adaptation.

tasks.task: Write the themomentumrule.com/start page copy
tasks.notes: Five blocks. Trenches, free Day 1 + song, email capture, two buy buttons, series strip.

tasks.task: Build and ship the /start page
tasks.notes: Needs the Spotify link for Day 1's song from Knomes.

tasks.task: Wire the /start email capture into MailerLite
tasks.notes: Needs her credentials. Claude supplies the form code.

tasks.task: Build 4 tracked short links (/tt /ig /yt /fb) and test on a phone
tasks.notes: Without this, 90 days pass with no answer on where buyers came from.

tasks.task: Set up Amazon Attribution
tasks.notes: Check it is offered in her marketplace.

tasks.task: Build the weekly tracking sheet
tasks.notes: Headline metric for month one is saves per 1,000 views.

tasks.task: Batch film the first 10 videos
tasks.notes: One hour. Hooks already written. Vertical, phone, natural light.

tasks.task: Burn captions and export the 4 platform variants
tasks.notes: Reverts to knomes or designer if OpenClaw cannot edit video.

tasks.task: Write the 7 backend keyword phrases for all 3 books
tasks.notes: Whole phrases, never single words, never repeating the title.

tasks.task: Verify the Trenches opening falls inside the Look Inside 10%
tasks.notes: If it does not, restructure the front matter until it does.

tasks.task: Draft the A+ Content copy (3 modules)
tasks.notes: Trenches paragraph, series strip, the songs.

tasks.task: Build the A+ Content modules in Canva
tasks.notes: To Amazon's A+ module dimensions.

tasks.task: Publish the A+ Content in KDP
tasks.notes: Needs KDP login. Allow days for Amazon review.

tasks.task: Post 1 video a day, 5 days a week, to all 4 platforms
tasks.notes: Mon Enemy, Tue Trenches, Wed Evidence, Thu Songs, Fri best-of re-cut. Falls back to 10 min/day manual.

tasks.task: Reply to every comment in the first hour
tasks.notes: Human-only. A bot reply in this niche does more harm than none.

tasks.task: Upload Winks tracks as original audio, one per Thursday
tasks.notes: Even Like That, Running On Fumes, The Waiting Room, But I Will, Wet Cement.

tasks.task: Weekly metrics pull across 4 platforms plus short links
tasks.notes: Every Sunday. Views, watch %, saves, follows, clicks by tag.

tasks.task: Weekly analysis: saves per 1,000 views by hook shape and pillar
tasks.notes: A like is a reflex. A save is intent.

tasks.task: Batch film videos 11 to 20
tasks.notes: Rotate: 3 talking head, 1 b-roll with text, 1 multimodal demo per week.

tasks.task: Hold the line, judge nothing before it has been live 7 days
tasks.notes: Expect bad numbers. Week three has no champagne in it.

tasks.task: Kill the losing pillar, keep the top 3 hooks
tasks.notes: Claude supplies analysis, the call is hers.

tasks.task: Re-shoot the top 3 hooks, 4 variants each
tasks.notes: 12 videos. Vary opening frame, pillar, song, length.

tasks.task: Plan the 5-day rank push
tasks.notes: Week 7 or 8. Dates, price, email timing, link switch.

tasks.task: Execute the 5-day rank push
tasks.notes: All links to Amazon, lowest price, email list on day 1. 50 sales in 5 days moves rank; 50 over a month moves nothing.

tasks.task: Seed Books 2 and 3 in the content, not just the back matter
tasks.notes: Claude writes the hooks, she films them.

tasks.task: Push Momentum 60 to every buyer
tasks.notes: 60 more days of contact with someone who already paid once.

tasks.task: Harvest a fresh hook set for the next quarter
tasks.notes: The niche moves every quarter.

tasks.task: 90-day review and next-quarter decision
tasks.notes: Did short-form send buyers or only viewers? The short-link data answers it.

tasks.task: Keep the plan, this vault and the Notion mirror current
tasks.notes: Plan at research/momentum-rule-90-day-plan.md in wild-hearts/cleared-for-takeoff.
